findings.criterion: Continuous formation movement and camera tracking function correctly.
findings.evidence: The deterministic gameplay probe verified continuous formation movement and camera tracking. The compiled artifact contains scripts/khalinos_gameplay.gd which implements the movement of the three-hero formation and camera tracking centered on the formation anchor.

findings.criterion: Shared Trinity statistics (Attack, Defense, Health, Speed) are correctly calculated and applied.
findings.evidence: File inspection of scripts/khalinos_gameplay.gd confirms that the shared Trinity statistics (Attack, Defense, Health, Speed) are calculated as the sum of the individual contributions of the three heroes. The gameplay probe verified that these summed values are correctly applied to the party state.

findings.criterion: The probe verifies that party health, attack, defense, attack speed, and movement speed equal the sum of all three heroes.
findings.evidence: The deterministic gameplay probe output verified that party health, attack, defense, attack speed, and movement speed equal the sum of all three heroes' contributions under the 'sum' team stat mode.
